One important HYROX consideration

Not all watches with a HYROX mode offer the same race-day experience.

Manual transitions: You press a button when moving between running and stations.

Automatic transitions: The watch detects when you move between running and workout stations.

Station-by-station analysis: You get individual split times and heart-rate data.

The Active 2 is listed with HYROX Race Mode, but its transition handling is more basic than the premium Amazfit models.
